gates.notes: Root cause isolated via docker logs source-codemie-1 and direct container inspection: ./codemie-storage inside the dockerized backend was owned by root:root mode 755 (mtime Sep 22, predating this session) while the app process runs as uid 1001 (codemie:codemie), so every file write hit PermissionError -> HTTP 500 on POST /v1/files/. Confirmed non-flaky across two runs against the unmodified container (16 failed, 32 rerun, 0 passed each time, including after a container restart). Fix applied directly: `docker exec -u root source-codemie-1 chown -R 1001:1001 ./codemie-storage` (verified via `ls -ld` showing ownership changed to codemie:codemie). Re-ran the same 16 node ids against this same dockerized backend post-fix: 16 passed, 1 rerun, 0 failed, 296.80s. file_system_repository.py and files.py are not in this branch's origin/main...HEAD diff, confirming this was pre-existing host-environment drift unrelated to EPMCDME-14349, now resolved at the environment level and independently re-verified against the real target backend (not a swapped-in alternate backend).
